text_en: It was reported to Holofernes, the general of the Assyrian army, that the people of Israel had prepared for war and had closed the mountain passes and fortified all the high hilltops and set up barricades in the plains.
text_cn: 那时，有人向亚述军队的统帅敖罗斐乃报告说：“以色列子民已准备应战，封锁山地隘口，在高山上修筑了防御工事，平原中已设下埋伏。”

text_en: In great anger he called together all the princes of Moab and the commanders of Ammon and all the governors of the coastland,
text_cn: 他遂勃然大怒，召集所有摩阿布的公侯，阿孟的司令，及沿海一带的长官来，

text_en: and said to them, “Tell me, you Canaanites, what people is this that lives in the hill country? What towns do they inhabit? How large is their army, and in what does their power and strength consist? Who rules over them as king and leads their army?
text_cn: 对他们说：“客纳罕的子民！请告诉我，这山地里住的是什么民族？他们住的是什么城池？部队的人数究有多少？他们的力量和勇气，究在什么事上？作他们的君王，率领他们军队的是谁？

text_en: And why have they alone, of all who live in the west, refused to come out and meet me? ”
text_cn: 为什么在西方诸民族中，只有他们不屑于前来欢迎我？”

text_en: Then Achior, the leader of all the Ammonites, said to him, “May my lord please listen to a report from the mouth of your servant, and I will tell you the truth about this people that lives in the mountain district near you. No falsehood shall come from your servant’s mouth.
text_cn: 于是全阿孟子民的统帅阿希约尔便对他说：“我主！请听你仆人一言，我要向你说明，这住在山地离你不远的民族，是什么情形；你仆人口中所说的，决没有一句虚话。

text_en: These people are descended from the Chaldeans.
text_cn: 这民族原是加尔底亚人的后裔，

text_en: At one time they lived in Mesopotamia, because they did not wish to follow the gods of their ancestors who were in Chaldea.
text_cn: 原先侨居在美索不达米亚，因为不愿随从自己祖先所居加尔底亚地的神祇，

text_en: Since they had abandoned the ways of their ancestors, and worshiped the God of heaven, the God they had come to know, their ancestors drove them out from the presence of their gods. So they fled to Mesopotamia, and lived there for a long time.
text_cn: 就离弃了自己祖先的途径，而崇拜天上的大主，一位自己所承认的神。所以他们被那里的神祇所驱逐，逃到美索不达米亚，侨居在那里很久。

text_en: Then their God commanded them to leave the place where they were living and go to the land of Canaan. There they settled, and grew very prosperous in gold and silver and very much livestock.
text_cn: 后来他们的天主，吩咐他们离开侨居的地方，往客纳罕地方去，就住在那里，积蓄了大批金银和很多家畜。

text_en: When a famine spread over the land of Canaan they went down to Egypt and lived there as long as they had food. There they became so great a multitude that their race could not be counted.
text_cn: 后又因客纳罕地方连年饥荒，便下到埃及，居留在那里， 直到他们能自养自足；在那里竟成了一个大族，子孙众多，不可胜数。

text_en: So the king of Egypt became hostile to them; he exploited them and forced them to make bricks.
text_cn: 但埃及王却苛待他们，逼令他们作做砖的苦工，压迫他们，当作奴隶。

text_en: They cried out to their God, and he afflicted the whole land of Egypt with incurable plagues. So the Egyptians drove them out of their sight.
text_cn: 于是他们向自己的天主哀号，天主就以不治之症，打击了埃及全境；埃及人就将他们赶走。

text_en: Then God dried up the Red Sea before them,
text_cn: 天主使红海在他们面前干涸，

text_en: and he led them by the way of Sinai and Kadesh-barnea. They drove out all the people of the desert,
text_cn: 引他们沿着西乃和卡德士巴尔乃亚的路前进，他们将旷野中的居民完全驱逐，

text_en: and took up residence in the land of the Amorites, and by their might destroyed all the inhabitants of Heshbon; and crossing over the Jordan they took possession of all the hill country.
text_cn: 住在阿摩黎人的境内，以武力消灭了一切赫市朋人， 继而渡过约但河， 占领了整个山地，据为己有，

text_en: They drove out before them the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Shechemites, and all the Gergesites, and lived there a long time.
text_cn: 将客纳罕人、培黎齐人、耶步斯人、舍根人与一切基尔加史人，都由自己的面前赶走，住在那里很久。

text_en: “As long as they did not sin against their God they prospered, for the God who hates iniquity is with them.
text_cn: 当他们不犯罪得罪自己的天主时，便常享幸福，因为有一位嫉恶的天主，与他们同在。

text_en: But when they departed from the way he had prescribed for them, they were utterly defeated in many battles and were led away captive to a foreign land. The temple of their God was razed to the ground, and their towns were occupied by their enemies.
text_cn: 但当他们离开天主给他们所指示的道路时，便在战争中受到歼灭，被掳到异乡，他们天主的殿宇也被毁为平地，城市都为敌人所占据。

text_en: But now they have returned to their God, and have come back from the places where they were scattered, and have occupied Jerusalem, where their sanctuary is, and have settled in the hill country, because it was uninhabited.
text_cn: 可是现在，自从他们归向天主以来，就由散居的地方回来，收复了他们的圣殿的所在地耶路撒冷，住在已变为荒芜的山地。

text_en: “So now, my master and lord, if there is any oversight in this people and they sin against their God and we find out their offense, then we can go up and defeat them.
text_cn: 主帅！假使这个民族作恶，得罪他们的天主，如果我们发觉他们有这“致命伤”，就可上去进攻，必能战胜。

text_en: But if they are not a guilty nation, then let my lord pass them by; for their Lord and God will defend them, and we shall become the laughingstock of the whole world. ”
text_cn: 若是这民族没有什么不法的事，请我主放过他们，免得他们的上主天主庇护他们，使我们在全世界成为人的笑柄。”

text_en: When Achior had finished saying these things, all the people standing around the tent began to complain; Holofernes’ officers and all the inhabitants of the seacoast and Moab insisted that he should be cut to pieces.
text_cn: 阿希约尔一说完这些话，站在营幕周围的众人，怨声四起，敖罗斐乃的军官和一切住在沿海与摩阿布一带的人，都声言要将他碎尸万段：

text_en: They said, “We are not afraid of the Israelites; they are a people with no strength or power for making war.
text_cn: “我们不应该怕以色列子民！这个民族决没有勇气和能力，与劲旅相对抗。

text_en: Therefore let us go ahead, Lord Holofernes, and your vast army will swallow them up. ”
text_cn: 敖罗斐乃主帅！我们应上前进攻，他们必能为你的全军所扑灭。”
